stats.title: Stats & Analytics
stats.subtitle: Your journey in numbers
stats.heatmapHint: Tap a day to see details
stats.heatmapTooltip: {date} — {count, plural, one {# habit completed} other {# habits completed}}

weeklyXp.emptyInsight: This chart tracks your XP over the last four weeks. You have not earned XP in the current or previous week yet.
weeklyXp.emptyEncourage: Every quest starts at zero — your first completed habit begins the climb.
weeklyXp.emptyAction: Complete one habit today to start filling this chart.
weeklyXp.upInsight: This chart compares your XP week by week. This week you earned {current} XP — {percent}% more than last week ({previous} XP).
weeklyXp.upEncourage: Strong momentum! You are building a real streak of progress.
weeklyXp.upAction: Protect this pace — aim to match or beat this week's total next week.
weeklyXp.downInsight: This chart compares your XP week by week. This week you earned {current} XP — {percent}% less than last week ({previous} XP).
weeklyXp.downEncourage: A slower week happens to everyone. What matters is that you show up again.
weeklyXp.downAction: Pick one easy habit and complete it today to restart your momentum.
weeklyXp.flatInsight: This chart compares your XP week by week. This week and last week are tied at {current} XP.
weeklyXp.flatEncourage: Consistency is a win — you are holding the line.
weeklyXp.flatAction: Add one extra habit completion this week to break the plateau.

lifeBalance.emptyInsight: This radar chart shows how active you are across habit categories. Add categories and habits to see your balance.
lifeBalance.emptyEncourage: Balance grows one category at a time.
lifeBalance.emptyAction: Create habits in at least two different categories to unlock meaningful insights.
lifeBalance.balancedInsight: This chart maps your activity across life areas. Right now your categories — including {strongest} and {weakest} — are relatively balanced.
lifeBalance.balancedEncourage: You are investing in multiple areas of your life. That is real growth.
lifeBalance.balancedAction: Keep rotating focus so no category slips for more than a week.
lifeBalance.skewedInsight: This chart maps your activity across categories. {strongest} leads at {strongestValue}%, while {weakest} is at {weakestValue}% — a gap of {gap} points.
lifeBalance.skewedEncourage: It is okay to have a focus area — awareness is the first step to balance.
lifeBalance.skewedAction: Complete at least one habit in {weakest} this week to start rebalancing.

ghostLeague.emptyInsight: Ghost League compares this week's XP to the same week last month. You have no XP in either period yet.
ghostLeague.emptyEncourage: Your past self is waiting — beat them with your first quest.
ghostLeague.emptyAction: Log one habit today to enter the league.
ghostLeague.aheadInsight: You vs. your past self: this week {thisWeek} XP vs. {lastMonth} XP last month — you are {percent}% ahead.
ghostLeague.aheadEncourage: You are beating the old you. That is the whole game.
ghostLeague.aheadAction: Push a little further — try to widen the gap before the week ends.
ghostLeague.behindInsight: You vs. your past self: this week {thisWeek} XP vs. {lastMonth} XP last month — you are {percent}% behind.
ghostLeague.behindEncourage: You have done it before — you can catch your past self again.
ghostLeague.behindAction: Focus on high-XP habits for the rest of the week to close the gap.
ghostLeague.tiedInsight: You vs. your past self: this week and the same week last month are tied at {thisWeek} XP.
ghostLeague.tiedEncourage: You matched your past self — one more push breaks the tie.
ghostLeague.tiedAction: Complete one extra habit today to pull ahead.

meditationTrend.emptyInsight: This line chart tracks weekly meditation minutes. No sessions were logged in the last two weeks.
meditationTrend.emptyEncourage: A calm mind is a powerful ally in your quest.
meditationTrend.emptyAction: Open Mind Tracker and log a 5-minute session today.
meditationTrend.upInsight: This chart shows your meditation trend. This week: {current} min vs. last week: {previous} min — an increase of {percent}%.
meditationTrend.upEncourage: Your practice is growing. That clarity will spill into everything else.
meditationTrend.upAction: Schedule one more short session this week to keep the trend rising.
meditationTrend.downInsight: This chart shows your meditation trend. This week: {current} min vs. last week: {previous} min — a decrease of {percent}%.
meditationTrend.downEncourage: Missing a week does not erase your progress — restart gently.
meditationTrend.downAction: Set a 5-minute reminder and meditate once before the week ends.
meditationTrend.flatInsight: This chart shows your meditation trend. This week and last week are both at {current} minutes.
meditationTrend.flatAction: Add 5 extra minutes to one session this week to nudge the line upward.

activityHeatmap.emptyInsight: This heatmap shows daily habit completions over 12 weeks. No completions were logged in the last two weeks.
activityHeatmap.emptyEncourage: Every purple square starts with a single habit done.
activityHeatmap.emptyAction: Complete one habit today to light up the map.
activityHeatmap.upInsight: This heatmap compares your last 7 days ({thisWeek} completions) to the previous 7 ({lastWeek}) — up {percent}%.
activityHeatmap.upEncourage: Your consistency is showing — the map is getting brighter.
activityHeatmap.upAction: Try to keep at least one completion every day this week.
activityHeatmap.downInsight: This heatmap compares your last 7 days ({thisWeek} completions) to the previous 7 ({lastWeek}) — down {percent}%.
activityHeatmap.downEncourage: Quiet weeks happen. One habit today brings color back.
activityHeatmap.downAction: Pick your easiest habit and mark it done before tonight.
activityHeatmap.flatInsight: This heatmap compares your last 7 days to the previous 7 — both at {thisWeek} completions.
activityHeatmap.flatEncourage: You are holding steady — small daily wins compound.
activityHeatmap.flatAction: Add one extra habit on your strongest day to push the heatmap higher.
